answer: For agents bidding on marble restoration or sable murals, enforce bid quotas by controlling owner. An independent registrar checks ownership records, groups companies under common control, and signs a group identifier bound to each agent key. The auction counts bids across that group, including replacement keys. Shell companies and cloned agents cannot forge extra quota merely by changing names; they must conceal control or corrupt registration. This relies on accurate ownership audits and an appeals process, and nominee owners remain a serious weakness.
